_comment: Shared cases for a step's signal path: the mechanism that produces its evidence. Two implementations read steps: the Composer, Lanes lens, execution timeline and Runs topology derive it in the browser (ui/src/components/console/composerSignal.js) and the scenario loader's S-28 lint and the corpus tripwire derive it in Python (core/engine/signal_path.py). Both suites assert every case here. `plugins` is the EAL registry split into collector-class (records POSTed to a collector) and wire-class (traffic generators); a Python test pins it to the live registry. Design: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-10-composer-doors-design.md.

cases.label: collector-class plugin run from the beacon

step.command:
cat > /tmp/c.yml <<'YML'
campaign_id: CMP-T
steps:
  - step_id: step-01
    plugin: ngfw_eal_emitter
    params: {}
YML
python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli run /tmp/c.yml --live

cases.label: wire-class plugin run from the beacon (the SIM-AIACC-003 burst)

step.command:
cat > /tmp/c.yml <<'YML'
campaign_id: CMP-T
steps:
  - step_id: step-01
    plugin: llm_provider_egress
    params: {}
YML
python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli run /tmp/c.yml --live

cases.label: two plugins of one class, names sorted and unique

step.command:
cat > /tmp/c.yml <<'YML'
campaign_id: CMP-T
steps:
  - step_id: step-01
    plugin: idp_signin_emulator
    params: {}
  - step_id: step-02
    plugin: email_emitter
    params: {}
  - step_id: step-03
    plugin: idp_signin_emulator
    params: {}
YML
python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli run /tmp/c.yml --live

cases.label: plugins of both classes are not guessed

step.command:
cat > /tmp/c.yml <<'YML'
campaign_id: CMP-T
steps:
  - step_id: step-01
    plugin: ngfw_eal_emitter
    params: {}
  - step_id: step-02
    plugin: c2_http_beacon
    params: {}
YML
python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli run /tmp/c.yml --live

cases.label: a plugin the registry does not know

step.command:
cat > /tmp/c.yml <<'YML'
campaign_id: CMP-T
steps:
  - step_id: step-01
    plugin: made_up_emitter
    params: {}
YML
python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli run /tmp/c.yml --live

cases.label: an EAL run that names no plugin

step.command: python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli run /tmp/c.yml --live

cases.label: describing a plugin emits nothing: a preflight on the host

step.command: python3 -m scripts.eal_simulator.cli describe llm_provider_egress | jq -e '.eal_targets | length > 0'

cases.label: an eal-channel step runs in SimCore's process
an eal-channel wire plugin
an eal-channel step with no plugin yet (a draft in progress)
a direct AWS API call

step.command:
aws sts get-caller-identity
aws s3 ls

cases.label: kubectl inside a command substitution

step.command:
POD=$(kubectl get pods -o name | head -1)
echo "$POD"

cases.label: a provider subcommand of a scanner still calls the provider

step.command: prowler aws --region us-east-1

cases.label: a cloud CLI named only inside quotes is not a call

step.command:
echo 'maps to: aws sts get-caller-identity'
sleep 2

cases.label: a cloud CLI named only in a comment is not a call

step.command:
# aws s3 cp would go here
sleep 5

cases.label: a longer word containing a CLI name is not a call

step.command:
/usr/bin/awslogs-agent --check
kubectl-plugin-x

cases.label: echo and sleep only: the step produces nothing itself

step.command:
echo '[CortexSim] waiting for the AI-SPM scan'
sleep "${WAIT_SECONDS:-900}"

cases.label: separators split quiet commands

step.command: echo start; sleep 3 && true || :

cases.label: echo redirected to a file is an action

step.command: echo marker > /tmp/cortexsim.flag

cases.label: echo piped to another program is an action

step.command: echo ping | nc 10.0.0.5 4444

cases.label: command substitution inside double quotes runs

step.command: echo "t1 = $(cat /tmp/t1.txt)"

cases.label: a redirect inside quotes is text, not an action

step.command: echo 'a > b | c'

cases.label: an empty command does nothing
the Composer's blank-step placeholder does nothing

step.command: # configure the command for this step

cases.label: a command the beacon runs on the host

step.command: cat /etc/shadow

cases.label: a plain curl C2 beacon is endpoint runtime: the lane names the mechanism, not the observer

step.command: curl -s http://c2.lab.test/beacon -o /dev/null

cases.label: a step whose command is not known (the list projection, or a run whose scenario did not load)
